# Contains typosquatting packages (suspicious)
# Note: These are intentionally misspelled popular packages
# In real world, attackers publish packages with names like these

# Legitimate package
numpy==1.24.3

# Typosquats (Levenshtein distance = 1 from popular packages)
# torh is distance 1 from torch (one character substitution)
# troch is distance 1 from torch (one character swap)

# For testing purposes, we'll reference these as if they exist
# (pip-audit won't actually find them, but our analyzer will flag the names)
torh==2.0.0
troch==2.0.0
tensorflo==2.13.0
transformres==4.30.0
